name: splitter
label: Splitter
description: A draggable split layout with resizable panes. Lay panes out horizontally or vertically with a slim, grabbable gutter between them. Nest splitters for complex layouts.

props.name: direction
props.description: Lay panes side by side (horizontal) or stacked (vertical).

props.name: gutterSize
props.description: Thickness of the draggable gutter in pixels.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Minimum size (px) each pane can shrink to.

props.name: pane:minSize
props.description: Per-pane minimum size in px (data-min-size); overrides the splitter-level minSize. Set 0 to allow full collapse.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: localStorage key holding an array of pane percentages. When set, the splitter restores that layout at init (before Split.js loads), so persisted layouts render on the first paint. Persist sizes yourself from the 'splitter-resized' event.

slots.name: slot
slots.default:
Pane A
Pane B

studio.container: {{component}}

usage: Loads Split.js from a CDN automatically. Compose with <x-splitter.pane> children and give each an optional size to set its initial percentage. When the splitter sits inside a Livewire component, place an <x-splitter.gutter /> between each pair of panes (and wire:key the panes): Split.js adopts the server-rendered gutters, so Livewire morphs see the same children the server rendered and never move the panes — a moved pane reloads any iframe inside it. Dispatch window events to control it: 'splitter-set-sizes' ({sizes: [..]}) resizes panes programmatically, 'splitter-init' rebuilds, 'splitter-set-direction' flips orientation. The root element emits bubbling 'splitter-resized' ({sizes}) after drags and programmatic resizes, and 'splitter-initialized' ({sizes}) once Split.js is up.
